blob: mesoscopic numerical simulation during selective laser melting of maraging steel 摘要： 激光选区熔化(selective laser melting, slm)成形过程涉及多种发生于介观尺度下的物理现象,采用试验方法难以揭示物理现象复杂的形成规律。以 18ni-300 马氏体时效钢为 slm 成形材料,采用离散元法与有限体积法建立了 slm 成形介观尺度热流耦合数值模型,并结合熔道成形试验验证模型的正确性。结合数值模拟揭示激光功率从 60 w 增加至 270 w 时单道 slm成形熔道形貌、熔池尺寸与温度、传热机制等熔池行为的基本特征;研究在 0.2 j/mm、0.3 j/mm 和 0.45 j/mm 线能量密度下不同激光功率和扫描速度组合对熔道形貌、熔池尺寸与传热机制的影响规律;结合熔道搭接理论模型计算激光功率 180 w 和扫描速度 600 mm/s 组合下无搭接缺陷的扫描间距理论临界条件约为 83 μm,并研究 80 μm、100 μm 和 120 μm 扫描间距下多道多层 slm 成形熔道搭接行为和演变规律。该模型可用于筛选工艺参数区间,提高工艺优化效率,为单层/多层成形的工艺试验提供指导。 ong jun, tang qian, luo zhichao, feng qixiang, nie yunfei journal of mechanical engineering 1. college of mechanical and vehicle engineering, chongqing university, chongqing 400044;2. state key laboratory of materials processing and die & mould technology, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;3. school of advanced manufacturing engineering, chongqing university of posts and telecommunications, chongqing 400065

blob: study on regional continuous energy control scanning method for selective laser melting 摘要： 针对激光选区熔化(selective laser melting，slm)成形悬垂结构件中存在的翘曲、挂渣等成形质量问题，基于局部区域传热差异性和层间热量传递性研究成形过程中已凝固实体与粉末分布对温度分布的影响，从而对悬垂件的成形进行优化。建立了基于零件几何信息驱动的能量调控优化模型，通过识别模型的几何特征，根据局部区域内的凝固实体和材料粉末的比例计算能量影响因子，实现基于软件自适应调节的变工艺参数的定域定量扫描，最终实现区域能量连续调控与工艺优化。选取典型悬垂件进行316l材料的打印实验作为验证，结果表明相较于未优化的普通扫描方案，基于软件自动能量调控的优化扫描方案可以提高小于45°倾角的悬垂结构件的成形质量，成形40°悬垂结构件时，变参数成形的悬垂面面平均粗糙度sa(surface average roughness)达24.03 μm，相比定参数成形的sa为46.32 μm，表面光洁度明显提高；同时可无支撑成形8 mm跨度的水平悬垂件。 qin lin, zhang lichao, wang senlin, tang mingkai, shi yusheng journal of mechanical engineering 1. school of materials science and engineering, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;2. school of machinery and automation, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081

title: Region Performance Matching Forming Method for Selective Laser Melting Based on Feature Recognition of Skeleton Line
authors: HE Junchi, ZHANG Lichao, WANG Senlin et al.
blob: region performance matching forming method for selective laser melting based on feature recognition of skeleton line 摘要： 对于激光选区熔化成形存在如薄壁和尖角等特征区域的零件，不同特征区域在真实服役场景下的性能需求和与之匹配的最佳工艺策略不尽相同。针对现有激光选区熔化工艺规划及加工软件中缺乏支持各类特征区域提取并匹配不同工艺策略的情况，提出一种基于骨架线特征识别的激光选区熔化区域性能匹配成形方法，实现薄壁、尖角和大平面等区域匹配性能需求工艺策略的一体化成形。通过仿真或实验确定各特征区域的性能需求，再提取切片轮廓的主骨架线，并依据其特征对切片轮廓进行区域划分，同时通过工艺数据库确定匹配各区域性能需求的工艺策略，将匹配性能需求的工艺策略赋予相应区域并打印成形零件。使用ti6al4v材料打印航空航天中常用的叶轮零件等比例缩小模型进行实验，确定叶轮的性能需求为中心处所需抗拉强度大和叶片处所需塑性好，提取叶轮切片轮廓并设置分区参数从而划分叶轮中心处和叶片处，然后将实验得到的工艺策略分别赋予叶轮中心处和叶片处并打印成形零件，最后对两处的微观组织进行分析，验证了方法的可行性。本项目所提出的基于骨架线特征识别的slm区域性能匹配成形方法可有效实现区域性能可调控零件的一体化制造，使零件在服役过程满足不同区域对性能的 该论文仅涉及lpbf工艺优化，未涉及生物医学材料的多孔结构、力学适配或骨整合，与用户研究方向的关联性较弱。 针对slm零件中不同特征区域（如薄壁、尖角）性能需求不同，现有工艺规划缺乏区域特征提取与匹配策略的问题。 提出基于骨架线特征识别的区域性能匹配方法，提取切片轮廓主骨架线进行区域划分，并通过工艺数据库赋予各区域匹配的工艺策略。 以ti6al4v叶轮为案例，成功实现了中心高强度与叶片高塑性的差异化工艺匹配，验证了方法的可行性。 通过打印叶轮缩比模型并进行微观组织分析进行了实验验证，但仅限于航空零件，无生物医学相关实验。 am_ti6al4v additivemanufacturing_slm he junchi, zhang lichao, wang senlin, tang mingkai, shi yusheng journal of mechanical engineering 1. school of materials science and engineering, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;2. school of machinery and automation, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081

title: Analysis of Plume Motion Characteristics in Selective Laser Melting Forming Process Based on Image Semantic Segmentation and Graph Convolution
authors: LIN Xin, MAO Yangkun, FUH Ying Hsi Jerry et al.
blob: analysis of plume motion characteristics in selective laser melting forming process based on image semantic segmentation and graph convolution 摘要： 现有的研究中羽流已被证明与选区激光熔融加工过程有着密切关系且影响了最终成形质量，如何利用羽流等监测信息揭示选区激光熔融成形过程中熔融状态，是选区激光熔融成形过程监测被广泛关注的重要原因之一。为了更加完善地描述羽流信息，采用deeplabv3+网络对图像进行语义分割，并使用标记图法建立一维的羽流形态特征；同时结合时序信号，构建图卷积自编码器与分类器，提出一种基于图结构的羽流运动特征，并进行聚类，得到熔融状态分类，讨论加工过程中羽流运动特征和熔融状态的关系。采用图卷积编码羽流动态特征，实现特征建立与熔融状态识别，并通过输出图卷积表征值，对图卷积在羽流特征提取中的应用进行可解释性分析。结果表明，提出的羽流特征能够实现五类熔融状态的识别且准确率达到了81.52%，并通过可解释性分析了羽流动态特征与熔融状态的内在关系，为选区激光熔融成形过程中监测信号与成形质量映射关系研究提供了新的思路。 lin xin, mao yangkun, fuh ying hsi jerry, zhu kunpeng journal of mechanical engineering 1. precision manufacturing institute, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081;2. key laboratory of metallurgical equipment and control technology, ministry of education, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081;3. institute of intelligent machines, hefei institutes of physical science, chinese academy of sciences, hefei 230031;4. national university of singapore (suzhou) research institute, suzhou 215123

blob: towards modeling uncertainties of self-explaining neural networks via conformal prediction despite the recent progress in deep neural networks (dnns), it remains challenging to explain the predictions made by dnns. existing explanation methods for dnns mainly focus on post-hoc explanations where another explanatory model is employed to provide explanations. the fact that post-hoc methods can fail to reveal the actual original reasoning process of dnns raises the need to build dnns with built-in interpretability. motivated by this, many self-explaining neural networks have been propose 该论文为纯机器学习不确定性方法，不涉及生物力学代理建模、fea采样效率或植入物设计，无直接相关性。 现有自解释神经网络缺乏对预测和解释的分布无关不确定性量化，且未能建立解释层置信度与预测层置信度之间的关联。 提出一种基于共形预测的不确定性建模框架，为自解释网络同时提供对解释和预测的不确定性估计。 实验证明该框架在分布无关不确定性建模方面表现有效，能生成高效且有效的预测集。 仅在标准机器学习数据集上实验验证，无实际工程或生物医学实验。 ml_uncertaintyquantification ml_explainability wei qian, chenxu zhao, yangyi li, fenglong ma, chao zhang arxiv preprint

title: Pontryagin Neural Operator for Solving Parametric General-Sum Differential Games
authors: Lei Zhang, Mukesh Ghimire, Zhe Xu et al.
blob: pontryagin neural operator for solving parametric general-sum differential games the values of two-player general-sum differential games are viscosity solutions to hamilton-jacobi-isaacs (hji) equations. value and policy approximations for such games suffer from the curse of dimensionality (cod). alleviating cod through physics-informed neural networks (pinn) encounters convergence issues when differentiable values with large lipschitz constants are present due to state constraints. on top of these challenges, it is often necessary to learn generalizable values and policies  方法学上属于pinn与神经算子方向，但应用领域为博弈论，不能直接迁移至植入物fea或生物打印。 解决参数化微分博弈中高维hji方程的求解效率和泛化问题。 提出pontryagin神经算子，引入基于协态损失的训练策略，利用前后向协态轨迹的差异来学习具有大lipschitz常数的值函数。 在参数化状态约束的博弈任务中，安全性能优于混合pinn模型。 仅通过数值实验验证，无真实实验或生物力学相关验证。 surrogatemodelling_pinn surrogatemodelling_neuraloperator lei zhang, mukesh ghimire, zhe xu, wenlong zhang, yi ren arxiv preprint

authors: Lamees R Alssum
blob: repeated implants failure in young patient with idiopathic nephrotic syndrome: a case report with brief review of the literature. background: nephrotic syndrome is a chronic disorder characterized by heavy proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, hyperlipidemia, and edema. idiopathic minimal-change disease is the most common form encountered in children. corticosteroids are the cornerstone for the treatment of idiopathic nephrotic syndrome (ins), with different regimens depending on the response to therapy and frequency of relapses. this case report presents complications after implant treatment in patient with ins. case presentation 与am生物医学材料、植入物设计或增材制造无关，纯临床病例报告。 报告一例肾病综合征年轻患者多次种植体失败的病例，探讨长期使用类固醇对骨代谢和种植体骨整合的影响。 通过病例展示和文献简要回顾，分析类固醇使用可能导致种植体失败的原因。 患者种植体出现松动和放射透光区，最终取出种植体并改用固定局部义齿修复。 无实验或制造验证，仅基于临床观察和文献回顾。 clinical_case report dental_implant failure lamees r alssum bmc oral health department of periodontics and community dentistry, college of dentistry, king saud university, riyadh, saudi arabia. lalssum@ksu.edu.sa.

title: A Molecular Dynamics Study of Mechanical Properties of Vertically Stacked Silicene/MoS2 van der Waals Heterostructure

blob: a molecular dynamics study of mechanical properties of vertically stacked silicene/mos2 van der waals heterostructure silicene is an intriguing silicon allotrope with a honeycomb lattice structure similar to graphene with slightly buckled geometry. molybdenum disulfide (mos2), on the other hand, is a significant 2d transition metal dichalcogenide that has demonstrated promise in a variety of applications. van der waals heterostructures, which are created by stacking distinct 2d crystals on top of each other, are becoming increasingly important due to their unique optoelectronic and electromechanical properties. 该研究不涉及用户关注的增材制造、生物打印、髋关节植入物或仿真代理方法。 研究垂直堆叠的硅烯/mos2范德华异质结构的力学性能。 使用分子动力学模拟，在不同加载方向和温度下分析异质结构的响应和结构稳定性。 温度从100k升至600k时，异质结构的断裂强度降低40%，杨氏模量线性下降；mos2层主要决定弹性性质，硅烯层主导失效行为。 仅有模拟，无实验验证。 bishwajit kar, plabon paul, md arshadur rahman, mohammad jane alam khan arxiv preprint

blob: multifidelity domain decomposition-based physics-informed neural networks and operators for time-dependent problems multiscale problems are challenging for neural network-based discretizations of differential equations, such as physics-informed neural networks (pinns). this can be (partly) attributed to the so-called spectral bias of neural networks. to improve the performance of pinns for time-dependent problems, a combination of multifidelity stacking pinns and domain decomposition-based finite basis pinns is employed. in particular, to learn the high-fidelity part of the multifidelity model, a domain decom 方法可能具有可迁移性，但未解决生物力学设计中的约束和不确定性量化问题。 提高神经网络对多尺度时间相关问题的求解效率，克服频谱偏差。 结合多保真堆叠pinn和基于时间域分解的有限基pinn，通过域分解学习高保真部分。 在摆、双频问题和allen-cahn方程上，域分解方法显著改善了pinn和堆叠pinn的性能。 仅在数值算例中验证，无实验或临床应用验证。 fea_surrogate_multifidelity fea_surrogate_pinns fea_surrogate_domaindecomposition alexander heinlein, amanda a. howard, damien beecroft, panos stinis arxiv preprint

title: From Pure Mathematics to Macroscale Applications: The Genesis of Schwarzites
authors: Levi C. Felix, Rushikesh Ambekar, Raphael M. Tromer et al.
blob: from pure mathematics to macroscale applications: the genesis of schwarzites schwarzites are porous (spongy-like) carbon allotropes with negative gaussian curvatures. they were proposed by mackay and terrones inspired by the works of the german mathematician hermann schwarz on triply-periodic minimal surfaces (tpms). this review presents and discusses the history of schwarzites and their place among curved carbon nanomaterials. we summarized the main works on schwarzites available in the literature. we discuss their unique structural, electronic, thermal, and mechanical  论文涉及tpms结构和3d打印，与生物医学多孔植入物设计间接相关，但缺乏应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合等具体研究。 schwarzites是一种具有负高斯曲率的多孔碳同素异形体，其结构源于三重周期极小曲面，但合成困难，本文回顾其历史和潜在应用。 通过文献综述总结schwarzites的结构、电子、热学和力学性质，并讨论从原子模型到宏观3d打印模型的转化。 虽然碳基schwarzites的合成仍未实现，但3d打印的宏观模型已在包括生物医学在内的多个领域展示应用潜力。 主要为综述，无实验验证；提及3d打印但未具体说明制造工艺或力学测试。 ambiomed_tpms ambiomed_review levi c. felix, rushikesh ambekar, raphael m. tromer, cristiano f. woellner, varlei rodrigues arxiv preprint

title: Risk Factors for Discontinuation of Intravenous Patient-Controlled Analgesia in Patients Undergoing Total Hip Arthroplasty
authors: Michinori NASU, Hirofumi Oishi, Riho ARAI et al.

blob: risk factors for discontinuation of intravenous patient-controlled analgesia in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty 人工股関節置換術後における経静脈的患者自己調節鎮痛法（intravenous patient-controlled analgesia：ivpca）中止の危険因子を検討した．術後鎮痛として，持続投与とボーラス投与を併用したpcaポンプを用いてフェンタニルを投与した患者を対象とした．解析した268人のうち，ivpcaを中止した患者は95人であり，ivpca中止の原因は術後悪心・嘔吐が94人，錐体外路症状疑いが1人であった．ロジスティック回帰分析の結果，高齢，apfel score 3以上，ivpcaのフェンタニル投与速度0.35μg/kg/h以上がivpca中止の危険因子であった． 该论文与用户的研究方向（3d生物打印综述、髋关节植入物phd、fea替代方法、生物医学增材制造）均无直接关联。 探讨全髋关节置换术后经静脉患者自控镇痛（ivpca）中止的危险因素。 回顾性分析268例患者，使用逻辑回归分析年龄、apfel评分、芬太尼输注速度等变量。 高龄、apfel评分≥3、芬太尼输注速度≥0.35μg/kg/h是ivpca中止的独立危险因素。 仅有临床回顾性数据分析，无实验或仿真验证。 michinori nasu, hirofumi oishi, riho arai, toshiharu terasaki, takaya fukui the journal of japan society for clinical anesthesia department of anesthesiology, toyama prefectural central hospital

blob: effects of selective laser melting building directions and surface modifications on surface roughness of ti6al4v alloy abstract in this paper, the effect of building direction relative to the substrate (0°, 45°, and 90°) on the surface roughness of ti6al4v samples produced by selective laser melting (slm) has been investigated. after slm, the samples were subjected to different surface modifications, including acid etching (e) with hf, sandblasting (s) with al 2 o 3 and sandblasting + etching (se). surface roughness of the prepared samples were investigated by alicona infinite focus optical microscopy and scanni 报道了slm ti6al4v的表面粗糙度调控，与am生物医用材料（如髋关节植入物）相关，但未涉及多孔结构或力学性能。 研究选区激光熔化（slm）中构建方向（0°,45°,90°）和表面改性（酸蚀、喷砂等）对ti6al4v合金表面粗糙度的影响，以促进种植体骨整合。 采用slm制备不同构建方向的样品，并进行酸蚀（hf）、喷砂（al2o3）及喷砂+酸蚀处理，利用alicona infinite focus光学显微镜和sem表征表面粗糙度。 酸蚀处理在45°和90°方向增加粗糙度，0°方向降低；喷砂及喷砂+酸蚀有效降低所有方向粗糙度；90°酸蚀样品获得最佳粗糙度（ra=4.25±0.21 μm），有利于骨整合。 实验测量了表面粗糙度，有真实实验数据，但无力学或生物学验证。 am_biomedical_materials surface_roughness ti6al4v slm jános kónya, hassanen jaber, tünde anna kovács, hajnalka hargitai discover applied sciences doctoral school on materials sciences and technologies, óbuda university, budapest, hungary

blob: influence of processing parameters on the corrosion resistance of additively manufactured nitinol parts for biomedical applications the usefulness of additively manufactured (am) nitinol and ti6al4v parts for the aerospace, automotive, machine and tooling, and biomedical industries depends on how well they withstand corrosion. am is a manufacturing process that makes it possible to create intricate geometries at a reasonable price. although significant progress has been made in decreasing metal corrosion, not much research has been done on optimizing input processing parameters to lower corrosion rates. unique phase structur 虽然本文关注耐腐蚀性而非多孔结构或疲劳，但为lpbf工艺参数优化提供了参考，可间接支持生物医学植入物的制造。 增材制造金属部件的耐腐蚀性对生物医学应用至关重要，但优化工艺参数以降低腐蚀速率的研究不足。 在37°c的hanks和ringers溶液中，对l-pbf制造的niti和ti6al4v进行电化学测试，改变激光功率和扫描间距。 提高激光功率改善钝化层；ti6al4v比niti更耐腐蚀；减小扫描间距和降低激光功率可降低niti的腐蚀敏感性。 在模拟体液中进行了电化学实验验证，但无机械测试或生物体内验证。 ambiomed_corrosion lpbf_nitinol lpbf_ti64 neha agarwal, katelyn anne gallagher, shane keaveny, james g. carton, dermot brabazon results in materials advanced processing technology research centre, dublin city university, dublin, ireland

blob: determination of process parameters for selective laser melting of inconel 718 alloy through evolutionary multi-objective optimization selective laser melting (slm) is a sustainable process that offers various environmental benefits. however, the parts produced from slm process require post-processing treatments that increase the energy consumption. therefore, there is a need for optimization of slm input parameters to minimize the same. for this purpose, the data set on selectively laser-melted inconel 718 parts was obtained from the reference. an evolutionary neural net has been employed to model the objective functions: spec 该论文研究slm工艺优化，但材料为inconel 718，非生物医学常用材料，且未涉及多孔结构或力学性能评估，与用户的研究方向关联度低。 为了减少slm制造inconel 718零件的后处理能耗，需要优化工艺参数。 采用进化神经网络建模比能耗、相对密度和表面粗糙度三个目标函数，并进行三目标优化。 预测的最优参数与实验参数吻合良好，证明了策略的有效性。 有实验验证，预测与实验结果一致。 am_processoptimization materials_inconel jai tiwari, ersilia cozzolino, sivasrinivasu devadula, antonello astarita, k. hariharan materials and manufacturing processes department of materials science and engineering & research institute of advanced materials, seoul national university, seoul, republic of korea

title: Emerging Multiscale Biofabrication Approaches for Bacteriotherapy
authors: Roberta Rovelli, Beatrice Cecchini, Lorenzo Zavagna et al.
blob: emerging multiscale biofabrication approaches for bacteriotherapy bacteriotherapy is emerging as a strategic and effective approach to treat infections by providing putatively harmless bacteria (i.e., probiotics) as antagonists to pathogens. proper delivery of probiotics or their metabolites (i.e., post-biotics) can facilitate their availing of biomaterial encapsulation via innovative manufacturing technologies. this review paper aims to provide the most recent biomaterial-assisted strategies proposed to treat infections or dysbiosis using bacteriotherapy. we  与aiforbioprinting方向关联较低，但综述了生物打印在细菌疗法中的应用，可作为背景参考。 细菌疗法需要有效的益生菌递送系统，综述不同尺度的生物材料封装策略。 回顾水凝胶基装置从0d到3d的制造方法，包括电纺、电喷和3d生物打印。 总结了每种方法的优缺点及未来展望，提供了基于生物材料的细胞和后生元释放示例。 纯综述，无实验验证。 biofabrication_probioticencapsulation bioprinting_scaffoldfabrication roberta rovelli, beatrice cecchini, lorenzo zavagna, bahareh azimi, claudio ricci molecules department of civil and industrial engineering, university of pisa, 56122 pisa, italy

title: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification for Stochastic Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
authors: Jake J. Harmon, Svetlana Tokareva, Anatoly Zlotnik et al.
blob: adaptive uncertainty quantification for stochastic hyperbolic conservation laws we propose a predictor-corrector adaptive method for the study of hyperbolic partial differential equations (pdes) under uncertainty. constructed around the framework of stochastic finite volume (sfv) methods, our approach circumvents sampling schemes or simulation ensembles while also preserving fundamental properties, in particular hyperbolicity of the resulting systems and conservation of the discrete solutions. furthermore, we augment the existing sfv theory with a priori convergence results jake j. harmon, svetlana tokareva, anatoly zlotnik, pieter j. swart arxiv preprint

blob: ai in energy digital twining: a reinforcement learning-based adaptive digital twin model for green cities digital twins (dt) have become crucial to achieve sustainable and effective smart urban solutions. however, current dt modelling techniques cannot support the dynamicity of these smart city environments. this is caused by the lack of right-time data capturing in traditional approaches, resulting in inaccurate modelling and high resource and energy consumption challenges. to fill this gap, we explore spatiotemporal graphs and propose the reinforcement learning-based adaptive twining (rl-at) mecha 该论文聚焦智慧城市能源数字孪生，与用户的研究方向（生物打印、髋关节植入物、fea、生物医学增材制造）无任何关联。 当前数字孪生技术无法支持智慧城市环境的动态性，缺乏适时数据捕获导致建模不准确和资源消耗高。 提出基于强化学习的自适应孪生机制（rl-at），结合深度q网络（dqn）和时空图进行建模。 时空图在图形数据库上实现一致准确性和55%更高的查询性能，模型实现20%更低的开销和25%更低的能耗。 无实验验证，仅通过仿真和性能指标评估。 exclude_unrelated lal verda cakir, kubra duran, craig thomson, matthew broadbent, berk canberk arxiv preprint

authors: Stefano Markidis
blob: brain-inspired physics-informed neural networks: bare-minimum neural architectures for pde solvers physics-informed neural networks (pinns) have emerged as a powerful tool for solving partial differential equations~(pdes) in various scientific and engineering domains. however, traditional pinn architectures typically rely on large, fully connected multilayer perceptrons~(mlps), lacking the sparsity and modularity inherent in many traditional numerical solvers. an unsolved and critical question for pinn is: what is the minimum pinn complexity regarding nodes, layers, and connections needed to  提出最小化pinn架构的方法，可能有助于提高替代模型的计算效率，但缺乏对生物力学设计约束和不确定性的直接处理。 传统pinn架构庞大且缺乏稀疏性和模块化，探索最小化神经网络复杂度以求解pde。 结合脑启发模块化训练（bimt），通过稀疏化和模块化逐步将全连接网络缩减为最小架构。 成功获得仅需少量神经元的极简pinn架构，并能展示高频问题需要更多神经元的谱偏置现象。 仅在合成pde基准问题中验证，无实际工程或生物力学实验验证。 pinn_minimalarchitecture braininspired_ml pde_solver surrogatemodeling_general stefano markidis arxiv preprint

blob: mechanical properties of martensitic precipitation hardened stainless steel produced by selective laser melting martensitic precipitation hardened stainless steel, of which 17-4ph stainless steel is the most common, is used in various industrial fields due to its high strength and excellent corrosion resistance. the selective laser melting (slm) technique can produce complicated components using lower material quantities and fewer steps compared to traditional manufacturing methods. the aim of this paper is to study the influence of slm processing parameters, mainly laser power, scanning speed, and hatchi 该论文仅涉及通用不锈钢的slm工艺，未聚焦生物医用材料或骨科植入物相关性能（如多孔结构、疲劳、骨整合）。 研究slm工艺参数（激光功率、扫描速度、搭接率）对17-4ph不锈钢密度、显微硬度和拉伸强度的影响。 通过改变激光功率（150-200w）、扫描速度（200-400mm/s）和搭接率，制备试样并进行密度、硬度和拉伸测试。 提高激光功率或降低扫描速度可获得更高密度和拉伸强度，最优参数范围为激光功率150-200w、扫描速度200-400mm/s。 实验测试验证了工艺参数与力学性能的关联，但无生物医学相关验证。 additivemanufacturing_lpbf materials_17-4ph magdymohamed said elsharkawy, mohamed bayoumi, khalid abdelghany, haytham elgazzar journal of al-azhar university engineering sector advanced digital manufacturing department, central metallurgical research and development institute (cmrdi), cairo, egypt

blob: improving scan-power coordination in selective laser melting through master-slave cross-coupled iterative learning control abstract selective laser melting (slm) demands precise coordination between scanning motion and laser power modulation to achieve stable melt pool behavior and high geometric accuracy. however, mismatches in dynamic responses between scanning and power systems often degrade synchronization, especially under high-speed motion and sharp trajectory transitions. to address this issue, this paper proposes a master-slave cross-coupled iterative learning control (ccilc) framework to improve scan-power  该论文关注slm工艺中的扫描-功率协调控制，未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳或生物医学植入物相关研究。 this paper focuses on control system coordination in slm, not on porous structure design, stress shielding, mechanical testing, or biomedical implant applications. slm中扫描与功率动态响应不匹配导致熔池不稳定和几何误差。 提出主从交叉耦合迭代学习控制框架，结合扰动观测器和鲁棒反馈控制器。 扫描跟踪误差降低31.65%，轮廓误差降低22.12%，功率跟踪误差降低90.07%。 基于ethercat的slm平台实验验证。 mismatched dynamic responses between scanning and power systems in slm degrade synchronization and geometric accuracy. a master-slave cross-coupled iterative learning control framework with disturbance observers and robust feedback controllers is proposed. the method achieves 31.65% reduction in scanning tracking errors, 22.12% in contour errors, and 90.07% in power tracking errors. experimental validation on an ethercat-based slm platform. selective laser melting iterative learning control scan-power coordination ethercat selective laser melting 选区激光熔化 iterative learning control 迭代学习控制 cross-coupled control 交叉耦合控制 scan-power coordination 扫描-功率协调 disturbance observer 扰动观测器 ethercat ethercat总线 ruei-yu huang, yen-jen chen, chung-wei cheng, af lee the international journal of advanced manufacturing technology department of mechanical engineering, national yang ming chiao tung university, no. 1001, ta hsueh rd., east dist, hsinchu city, 300093, taiwan, roc

blob: random-set graph neural networks uncertainty quantification has become an important factor in understanding the data representations produced by graph neural networks (gnns). despite their predictive capabilities being ever useful across industrial workspaces, the inherent uncertainty induced by the nature of the data is a huge mitigating factor to gnn performance. while aleatoric uncertainty is the result of noisy and incomplete stochastic data such as missing edges or over-smoothing, epistemic uncertainty arises from lack of  该论文提出的随机集图神经网络不确定性量化方法可迁移至代理模型，用于评估植入物设计中的预测不确定性。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design applications. 图神经网络预测不确定性限制了其工业应用，需有效量化。 提出随机集图神经网络，用信念函数头建模节点级认知不确定性。 在9个图学习数据集上展示了优越的不确定性量化能力。 在标准图学习基准和自动驾驶数据集上验证。 uncertainty in gnn predictions hinders industrial adoption, necessitating a principled quantification framework. proposes random-set graph neural networks with a belief-function head that models epistemic uncertainty as random sets over class labels. rs-gnn achieves superior uncertainty quantification on 9 graph learning datasets, including autonomous driving benchmarks. validated on standard graph learning benchmarks and real-world autonomous driving datasets (nuscenes, road). graph neural networks uncertainty quantification epistemic uncertainty belief functions random sets graph neural networks 图神经网络 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 epistemic uncertainty 认知不确定性 belief functions 信念函数 random sets 随机集 node-level uncertainty 节点级不确定性 autonomous driving 自动驾驶 tommy woodley, shireen kudukkil manchingal, matteo tolloso, davide bacciu, fabio cuzzolin arxiv preprint

title: NOFE -- Neural Operator Function Embedding
authors: Lars Uebbing, Harald L. Joakimsen, Siyan Chen et al.
blob: nofe -- neural operator function embedding most dimensionality reduction methods treat data as discrete point clouds, ignoring the continuous domain structure inherent to many real-world processes. to bridge this gap, we introduce neural operator function embedding (nofe), a domain-aware framework for continuous dimensionality reduction. nofe learns function-to-function mappings via a graph kernel operator, enabling mesh-free evaluation at arbitrary query locations independent of input discretization. we establish nofe as approximation o 该论文提出了一种连续域降维方法，但未涉及有限元分析或生物力学设计，与用户研究方向关联度低。 this paper focuses on continuous dimensionality reduction for general data, with no application to fea, surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical implant design. 现有降维方法忽略数据的连续域结构，需提出域感知的连续降维方法。 提出神经算子函数嵌入（nofe），通过图核算子学习函数到函数映射，实现网格无关评估。 nofe在局部结构保持上显著优于pca、t-sne和umap，且具有鲁棒的采样独立性。 在era5气候再分析数据集上对比基线方法，计算局部stress和patch stitching error。 existing dimensionality reduction methods treat data as discrete point clouds, ignoring continuous domain structure, motivating a domain-aware continuous approach. neural operator function embedding (nofe) learns function-to-function mappings via a graph kernel operator, enabling mesh-free evaluation at arbitrary query locations. nofe achieves superior local structure preservation (local stress 0.111 vs. 0.398 for pca) and reduces patch stitching error by up to 20x compared to umap. validation is performed on the era5 climate reanalysis dataset against pca, t-sne, and umap using local stress and patch stitching error metrics. dimensionality reduction neural operator continuous embedding graph kernel operator neural operator 神经算子 dimensionality reduction 降维 continuous embedding 连续嵌入 graph kernel operator 图核算子 mesh-free evaluation 网格无关评估 sheaf neural network 层状神经网络 local structure preservation 局部结构保持 lars uebbing, harald l. joakimsen, siyan chen, georgios leontidis, kristoffer k. wickstrøm arxiv preprint

title: Compositional Neural Operators for Multi-Dimensional Fluid Dynamics
authors: Hamda Hmida, Hsiu-Wen Chang, Youssef Mesri
blob: compositional neural operators for multi-dimensional fluid dynamics partial differential equations (pdes) govern diverse physical phenomena, yet high-fidelity numerical solutions are computationally expensive and machine learning approaches lack generalization. while scientific foundation models (sfms) aim to provide universal surrogates, typical encoding-decoding approaches suffer from high pretraining costs and limited interpretability. in this paper, we propose compositional neural operators (compno) for 2d systems, a framework that decomposes complex pdes in 该论文提出的组合式神经算子框架可分解复杂pde为基本模块，有望迁移至生物力学fea代理建模，提高采样效率和可解释性。 this paper focuses on fluid dynamics pdes and does not include solid mechanics, implant design, or biomedical validation. 高保真数值求解计算昂贵，现有ml方法泛化性差。 将复杂pde分解为预训练的基础算子模块，通过聚合器学习非线性交互。 在多个流体方程上验证了模块化方法的适应性和可解释性。 在标准pde基准（对流扩散、burgers、不可压navier-stokes）上数值验证。 high-fidelity numerical pde solvers are computationally expensive, and existing ml surrogates lack generalization and interpretability. compno decomposes complex pdes into a library of pretrained foundation blocks (e.g., convection, diffusion) and assembles them via an adaptation block with physics-informed loss. the modular approach improves adaptability, interpretability, and enables reuse of pretrained blocks across different physical systems. numerical benchmarks on convection-diffusion, burgers', and incompressible navier-stokes equations. neural operator compositional pde surrogate foundation model fluid dynamics neural operator 神经算子 compositional framework 组合式框架 foundation model 基础模型 pde surrogate pde代理模型 physics-informed loss 物理信息损失 modular library 模块化库 convection-diffusion 对流扩散 burgers' equation burgers方程 navier-stokes navier-stokes方程 hamda hmida, hsiu-wen chang, youssef mesri arxiv preprint

title: VNDUQE: Information-Theoretic Novelty Detection using Deep Variational Information Bottleneck
authors: Aryan Gondkar, Hayder Radha, Yiming Deng
blob: vnduqe: information-theoretic novelty detection using deep variational information bottleneck detecting out-of-distribution (ood) samples is critical for safe deployment of neural networks in safety-critical applications. while maximum softmax probability (msp) provides a simple baseline, it lacks theoretical grounding and suffers from miscalibration. we propose vnduqe (vib-based novelty detection and uncertainty quantification for nondestructive evaluation), which investigates novelty detection through the deep variational information bottleneck (vib), which explicitly constrains inform 该论文研究基于信息瓶颈的ood检测，与fea代理模型或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on image-based ood detection with no fea or surrogate modeling context. 安全关键应用中神经网络ood检测需要理论支撑和校准。 使用深度变分信息瓶颈约束表示学习，结合kl散度和预测熵进行ood检测。 kl散度在远ood上达100% auroc，预测熵在近ood上达94.7% auroc。 在mnist留出类、噪声和域偏移上评估auroc和校准误差。 safe deployment of neural networks requires theoretically grounded and well-calibrated out-of-distribution detection. the deep variational information bottleneck is employed to constrain representation learning, and kl divergence and prediction entropy are used as complementary ood detection metrics. kl divergence achieves perfect far-ood detection (100% auroc on noise), while prediction entropy excels at near-ood detection (94.7% auroc on novel digits), with a combined strategy improving auroc by 32 percentage points over msp. validation is performed on mnist with held-out classes, noise, and domain shift, evaluating auroc and expected calibration error. novelty detection variational information bottleneck uncertainty quantification ood detection mnist out-of-distribution detection 分布外检测 variational information bottleneck 变分信息瓶颈 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 kl divergence kl散度 prediction entropy 预测熵 expected calibration error 期望校准误差 aryan gondkar, hayder radha, yiming deng arxiv preprint

title: Multi-Narrow Transformation as a Single-Model Ensemble: Boundary Conditions, Mechanisms, and Failure Modes
authors: Tatsuhito Hasegawa, Taisei Tanaka
blob: multi-narrow transformation as a single-model ensemble: boundary conditions, mechanisms, and failure modes single-model ensembles (smes) have attracted attention as a way to approximate some of the benefits of deep ensembles within a single network. however, under an approximately matched parameter budget, it remains unclear whether model capacity should be concentrated in a single wide pathway or redistributed into many narrow and independent members. we investigate this question through the multi-narrow (mn) transformation, which converts a baseline cnn into an sme of narrow, path-wise independent  该论文研究单模型集成中的多窄分支变换，与fea替代建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper focuses on cnn ensemble architectures for image classification, with no application to surrogate modeling, finite element analysis, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical design. 探索在参数预算有限时，模型容量应集中于单宽路径还是分散为多窄分支。 通过多窄变换将基线cnn转化为多个窄独立分支的集成，比较不同数据量下的性能。 低数据量下多窄模型优于基线，高数据量下则相反。 在多个cnn架构和图像分类数据集上验证。 to determine whether model capacity under a fixed parameter budget should be concentrated in a single wide pathway or distributed into many narrow independent branches in single-model ensembles. the multi-narrow transformation converts a baseline cnn into an ensemble of narrow, path-wise independent branches while preserving the dominant parameter budget, and compares performance across data regimes. highly partitioned multi-narrow models consistently outperform the baseline in low-data settings but underperform in data-rich settings, due to imbalanced training and path dominance. validated on multiple cnn architectures and image classification datasets (e.g., cifar, imagenet subsets). single-model ensemble multi-narrow transformation cnn image classification low-data regime single-model ensemble 单模型集成 multi-narrow transformation 多窄变换 parameter budget 参数预算 path-wise independence 路径独立性 low-data regime 低数据量场景 model capacity 模型容量 tatsuhito hasegawa, taisei tanaka arxiv preprint

title: Post-ADC Inference: Valid Inference After Active Data Collection
authors: Shuichi Nishino, Tomohiro Shiraishi, Teruyuki Katsuoka et al.
blob: post-adc inference: valid inference after active data collection the validity of statistical inference depends critically on how data are collected. when data gathered through active data collection (adc) are reused for a post-hoc inferential task, conventional inference can fail because the sampling is adaptively biased toward regions favored by the collection strategy. this issue is especially pronounced in black-box optimization, where sequential model-based optimization (smbo) methods such as the tree-structured parzen estimator (tpe) and gaussian process 该论文关注主动数据收集后的统计推断，而非解决有限元代理模型中的采样效率或约束优化问题。 this paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for point predictions, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design. 主动数据收集后统计推断失效，需校正采样偏差。 提出后adc推断框架，基于选择性推断校正数据收集和目标构建的双重偏差。 提供有效的p值和置信区间，适用于gp-ucb和tpe等算法。 数值基准测试验证推断有效性。 statistical inference fails when data are actively collected due to adaptive sampling bias, necessitating a correction framework. a post-adc inference framework is proposed, leveraging selective inference to correct biases from both the active data collection process and data-dependent target construction. valid p-values and confidence intervals are obtained for data collected by gp-ucb and tpe without assumptions on the black-box function. numerical benchmarks demonstrate the validity of the proposed inference method. active data collection selective inference black-box optimization gp-ucb tpe active data collection 主动数据收集 selective inference 选择性推断 black-box optimization 黑箱优化 gp-ucb 高斯过程上置信界 tpe 树结构parzen估计器 p-value p值 confidence interval 置信区间 shuichi nishino, tomohiro shiraishi, teruyuki katsuoka, ichiro takeuchi arxiv preprint

blob: spatial adapter: structured spatial decomposition and closed-form covariance for frozen predictors we present the spatial adapter, a parameter-efficient post-hoc layer that equips any frozen first-stage predictor with a structured spatial representation of its residual field and an induced closed-form spatial covariance. the adapter operates as a cascade second stage on residuals, jointly learning a spatially regularized orthonormal basis and per-sample scores via a tractable mini-batch admm procedure, without modifying any first-stage parameter. because the first-stage parameters are frozen, 该论文关注通用空间残差建模和协方差估计，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的有限元代理建模。 no fea surrogate modeling, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization. 为冻结的预测器提供结构化空间残差表示和闭式协方差。 提出空间适配器，通过admm学习正交基和分数，实现低秩加噪声协方差估计。 在合成数据和真实数据集上恢复空间结构，支持克里金预测和不确定性量化。 在合成数据、weather2k和gwhd上验证空间预测性能。 to equip any frozen first-stage predictor with a structured spatial representation of its residual field and a closed-form covariance for uncertainty quantification. the spatial adapter learns a spatially regularized orthonormal basis and per-sample scores via mini-batch admm, yielding a low-rank-plus-noise covariance estimator. the adapter recovers residual spatial structure across synthetic and real datasets, enabling kriging-style prediction with plug-in uncertainty. validated on synthetic data, weather2k spatial holdout prediction, and gwhd patch grids. spatial adapter covariance estimation frozen predictors kriging uncertainty quantification spatial adapter 空间适配器 closed-form covariance 闭式协方差 frozen predictor 冻结预测器 kriging 克里金 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 admm 交替方向乘子法 low-rank factorization 低秩分解 wen-ting wang, wei-ying wu, hao-yun huang, xuan-chun wang arxiv preprint

blob: suppression of powder spattering and melt pool instability in laser powder bed fusion via in-situ microwave volumetric scaffolding abstract laser-based powder bed fusion (pbf-lb) is limited by powder spattering and melt pool instability caused by direct laser irradiation of loose powder beds, leading to defects, material loss, and poor surface quality. this study introduces a hybrid microwave (mw)-laser strategy that decouples bed stabilisation from precision melting by transforming loose powder into a coherent scaffold prior to laser exposure. using copper as a model material, loose multimodal powder beds (0–3, 10–40, 45–1 该论文关注lpbf工艺稳定性，未涉及生物医学植入物的力学性能或骨整合。 no porous structure design for stress shielding, no mechanical testing (fatigue or static), no surface roughness or osseointegration data. 解决lpbf中粉末飞溅和熔池不稳定问题 引入微波预烧结形成粉末骨架，再进行激光熔化 完全消除粉末飞溅，熔池稳定，密度从69.2%提升至79.4% 高速成像观察粉末飞溅和熔池动态，密度测量 to suppress powder spattering and melt pool instability in laser powder bed fusion by pre-sintering the powder bed with microwaves. a hybrid microwave-laser strategy is introduced where loose powder is volumetrically pre-sintered into a coherent scaffold using a 2.45 ghz microwave source before laser melting. complete elimination of powder spattering and transition to stable melt pool dynamics are achieved, with density increasing from 69.2% to 79.4%. high-speed imaging and density measurements confirm the suppression of spattering and improved melt pool confinement. lpbf microwave sintering powder spattering melt pool stability copper laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 microwave sintering 微波烧结 powder spattering 粉末飞溅 melt pool stability 熔池稳定性 scaffold 骨架 copper 铜 mubasher ali, zhou su, wei hsin liao, hay wong progress in additive manufacturing

blob: topology-preserving neural operator learning via hodge decomposition in this paper, we study solution operators of physical field equations on geometric meshes from a function-space perspective. we reveal that hodge orthogonality fundamentally resolves spectral interference by isolating unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling an additive approximation confined to structure-preserving subspaces. building on hodge theory and operator splitting, we derive a principled operator-level decomposition. the result is a hybrid 该论文提出了一种基于hodge分解的拓扑保持神经算子，可提升物理场求解的精度和效率，对fea代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。 this paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, lacks experimental validation, and does not address uncertainty quantification or multi-objective constraints. 解决几何网格上物理场求解中谱干扰和拓扑自由度不可学习的问题 利用hodge正交性和算子分裂，提出混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构及hodge谱对偶归纳偏置 在几何图上实现了更高的精度和效率，并增强了对物理不变量的保真度 在数值基准测试上验证了方法的准确性和效率 to address spectral interference and unlearnable topological degrees of freedom in learning solution operators on geometric meshes. a hybrid eulerian-lagrangian architecture with hodge spectral duality inductive bias is derived via hodge orthogonality and operator splitting. the method achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on geometric graphs with enhanced fidelity to physical invariants. validation is performed on numerical benchmarks demonstrating accuracy and efficiency. neural operator hodge decomposition topology preservation geometric meshes physical invariants neural operator 神经算子 hodge decomposition hodge分解 topology preservation 拓扑保持 geometric mesh 几何网格 physical invariants 物理不变量 operator splitting 算子分裂 discrete differential forms 离散微分形式 inductive bias 归纳偏置 dongzhe zheng, tao zhong, christine allen-blanchette arxiv preprint

authors: Gordan Prastalo, Kevin Maik Jablonka
blob: reducing cross-sample prediction churn in scientific machine learning scientific machine learning reports predictive performance. it does not report whether the same prediction would survive a different draw of training data. across $9$ chemistry benchmarks, two classifiers trained on independent bootstraps of the same training set agree on aggregate accuracy to within $1.3\text{--}4.2$ percentage points but disagree on the class label of $8.0\text{--}21.8\%$ of test molecules. we call this gap \emph{cross-sample prediction churn}. the standard parameter-side tech 该论文关注科学机器学习中的预测一致性，而非fea代理建模或生物力学设计优化。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for point predictions, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design. 科学机器学习报告预测性能，但未报告不同训练数据下预测的一致性。 提出交叉样本预测波动概念，并采用k-bootstrap装袋和双bootstrap方法降低波动。 k-bootstrap装袋降低波动40-54%，双bootstrap进一步降低45%。 在9个化学基准数据集上验证，比较聚合准确率与标签不一致率。 scientific machine learning typically reports predictive performance but ignores whether predictions are consistent across different training data draws. the paper introduces cross-sample prediction churn and proposes k-bootstrap bagging and twin-bootstrap (joint training with sym-kl consistency loss) to reduce it. k-bootstrap bagging reduces churn by 40-54% with no accuracy loss, and twin-bootstrap further reduces it by a median 45% beyond bagging-k=2. validated on nine chemistry benchmarks by comparing aggregate accuracy and per-molecule label disagreement between classifiers trained on independent bootstraps. prediction churn scientific machine learning ensemble methods bootstrap chemistry benchmarks prediction churn 预测波动 scientific machine learning 科学机器学习 bootstrap 自助法 bagging 装袋 ensemble 集成 consistency loss 一致性损失 chemistry benchmark 化学基准 gordan prastalo, kevin maik jablonka arxiv preprint

blob: what's in a nam? the transition away from animal experimentation is gaining momentum across scientific disciplines, driven by technological advancements, ethical imperatives and policy support. at the forefront of this movement is the development of new approach methodologies (nams). rather than serving as mere substitutes for animal testing, nams represent a paradigm shift. their growing acceptance has been reinforced by recent policy advancements, such as the us food and drug administration modernization act 2 该论文主要讨论替代动物实验的新方法论(nams)，仅提及3d生物打印和ai作为技术工具，未深入ai与生物打印的具体结合。 this paper is a policy/definition review of nams, not an ai-bioprinting method; it lacks any ai integration into a bioprinting workflow stage and has no experimental validation. 动物实验替代方法(nams)定义模糊，需统一。 提出nams定义：不包括活体动物的物种特异性方法。 nams与3rs框架不同，强调目标物种直接使用。 无实验验证，为概念性讨论。 the term 'new approach methodologies' (nams) has become ambiguous, necessitating a unified definition to avoid confusion and misuse. a definition is proposed: nams are species-specific methodologies that exclude the use of living animals, prioritizing target species data. nams represent a paradigm shift from the 3rs framework, leveraging technologies like organoids, bioprinting, and ai for human-relevant research. no experimental validation; the paper is a conceptual and policy discussion. nams 3d bioprinting ai policy review new approach methodologies (nams) 新方法论(nams) 3rs framework 3rs框架 3d bioprinting 3d生物打印 artificial intelligence 人工智能 organ-on-chip 器官芯片 species-specific 物种特异性 animal-free regulatory system 无动物监管体系 arti ahluwalia, babette fletemeyer, giuseppe chirico, alisa elezovic, winfried neuhaus lab animal department of information engineering, university of pisa, pisa, italy. arti.ahluwalia@unipi.it.; centro 3r, pisa, italy. arti.ahluwalia@unipi.it.

blob: active learners as efficient prp rerankers pairwise ranking prompting (prp) elicits pairwise preference judgments from an llm, which are then aggregated into a ranking, usually via classical sorting algorithms. however, judgments are noisy, order-sensitive, and sometimes intransitive, so sorting assumptions do not match the setting. because sorting aims to recover a full permutation, truncating it to meet a call budget does not produce a dependable top-k. we thus reframe prp reranking as active learning from noisy pairwise comparisons an 该论文关注llm排序中的主动学习，与fea替代建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper does not address fea surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design. 解决llm排序中噪声大、预算有限的问题 将prp重排序视为带噪声比较的主动学习 主动排序器在调用受限时提升ndcg@10 在标准排序基准上评估 to address noisy and budget-constrained pairwise ranking in llm-based reranking. reframes prp reranking as active learning from noisy pairwise comparisons with a randomized-direction oracle. active rankers improve ndcg@10 under call constraints compared to sorting-based methods. evaluated on standard ranking benchmarks. active learning pairwise ranking llm reranking active learning 主动学习 pairwise ranking 成对排序 llm 大语言模型 reranking 重排序 noise-robust 噪声鲁棒 jeremías figueiredo paschmann, juan kaplan, francisco nattero santiago mauricio barron bucolo, juan wisznia, luciano del corro arxiv preprint

title: Risk Factors for Tibial Periprosthetic Fractures After Total Knee Arthroplasty: The Influence of Fixation and Implant Design.
authors: Amir H Hoveidaei, Chase W Smitterberg, Ronald E Delanois et al.

title: Resonance Frequency Analysis and Clinical Outcomes in Implant Dentistry: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
